description_en: Installs all currently available system MCP services for a specified Data Agent workspace
description_zh: 为指定 Data Agent 工作空间安装全部当前可用的系统 MCP 服务
name: InitWorkspaceSystemMcpServer

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Data Agent workspace for which to initialize system MCP services. The caller must have at least MEMBER permissions on the workspace
parameters.help_zh: 要初始化系统 MCP 服务的 Data Agent 工作空间 ID。调用者至少需要工作空间 MEMBER 权限
parameters.name: workspace_id

Data.description_en: Indicates whether all system MCP services are initialized successfully. Returns true even when no system MCP services are available
Data.description_zh: 系统 MCP 服务是否全部初始化成功。没有可用系统 MCP 时也返回 true

ErrorCode.description_en: The return code. The value success is returned for successful requests. An error code is returned for failed requests
ErrorCode.description_zh: 返回码。请求成功时为 success；请求失败时为对应的错误码

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when a system-level request failure occurs
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 系统级请求失败时返回的错误信息
ErrorMessage.example: Failed to initialize workspace system MCP servers

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate this call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次调用

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was processed successfully. Valid values:
true: Succeeded.
false: Failed
Success.description_zh: 请求处理是否成功。取值为 true 表示成功，取值为 false 表示失败
